title: How to Localize the Website
text:
## How to Localize the Website
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000003018
The Primary Country setting is used to fall back on or recommend to users when maps/map searches are needed.

## Primary Country Setting
Go into Settings >>  General Settings >> Localization:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12177863202/original/LrQp3KAsYY6PHoWgQNgsJqMH1-Wn917wlQ.png?1776864874 | alt: ]

## Location Search Suggestions
By default, whenever a user does a search by location, it will recommend suggestions from all around the world; however, if the website is intended to be used in one country only, the searches should be in the intended country.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12177864272/original/FWiK6L7xdcCWAW4Vrks3i1iqoXN0c2iOMw.png?1776866006 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12177864303/original/nbmLLnV0Q-ncToNz1FtItRSbx4n7b123Nw.png?1776866036 | alt: ]

## Default Map Pin
The Primary Country setting is also used to set the default map pin:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12107661987/original/RwEkMEbbhCutel2HccGGxk-K1N6M2pBrIw.png?1649915304 | alt: ]
This applies to the following forms:
Lead Form
Member Contact Details ( shown above )
Service Areas
Single Image and Group Posts
The map pin location can be customized using the advanced settings

## Default Center Map Location
System Variable : default_center_map_lat_lon
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12177863372/original/wgO1DTs9o7-d1NeYeFn7xkaedntt8harKw.png?1776865106 | alt: ]
When using this setting, add the latitude and longitude coordinates separated by commas.
Example: 41.019696,-99.888992

## Service Areas Display Behavior
Also, if the Location Search Suggestions setting is configured to Include All Countries , the country associated with the Service Areas will be displayed:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12177600173/original/yyaSW-Sej13AjU8GLux1SBACmNUEXdYZ7Q.jpeg?1776359243 | alt: ]
If the setting is configured to Only Search Within Primary Country , the country associated with the Service Areas will be hidden:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12177600190/original/MUq1OBd2c8DpQfqLuUgOwuyuMlNoV3lLcg.jpeg?1776359255 | alt: ]
